title: Patch: friends in the top-right corner of every screen, and challenging a friend in fewer steps
thread:
**Issue #1831 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1831: Patch: friends in the top-right corner of every screen, and challenging a friend in fewer steps
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Today a player's friends live on one page, `/together` (`apps/web/src/together/TogetherRoute.tsx`), reached from the `/play` hub. To challenge a friend you leave the screen you're on, open Play together, press Challenge, pick a mode and a deck in `ChallengeDialog.tsx`, and send. The friend then presses Accept on the toast (`ChallengeToast.tsx`), lands on `/play` with the code filled in (R767), picks a deck and presses Join. That's too many steps, and friends are out of sight on every other screen.

This patch puts friends in the **top-right corner of every screen**, always there for a signed-in active account, and cuts the steps on both sides of a challenge. SPEC §9.5 ("Play together", "Challenging a friend") and R767 describe the current flow, so the spec text changes with the code (CLAUDE.md rule 1, rule 3).

**1. A Friends button in the top-right cluster, on every screen**
- A new `together/FriendsButton.tsx` sits in the top-right control group, to the left of the language button and the settings gear, everywhere those two appear: `routes/nav.tsx`'s `BackLink` (every inner screen), the landing (`routes/landing.tsx`), the match board's bar (`game/Board.tsx`, `placement="game"`), the practice and lesson HUDs, the Duos board, the replay player and `/watch`. Match `SettingsButton`'s `placement` prop and its popover pattern.
- Show it only while the tab holds a session for an active account (the same `signedIn` read `main.tsx` uses for `ChallengeToast`). Hide it on signed-out screens (sign-in, password reset), as the Jlore pill is.
- A badge on the button counts what needs the player: incoming friend requests plus incoming challenges plus unread chats. Take these numbers from the reads the shell already makes every `SOCIAL_POLL_MS` (the challenge toast's `GET /api/challenges` and the unread counts). Share one poll and add no new one, so server load stays as it is.
- On the match board, this button replaces `InMatchChat.tsx`'s separate rail toggle, so there is one friends entry, not two. Chat keeps working from inside the panel.

**2. The friends panel**
- Pressing the button opens a panel: a popover on desktop, a full-width sheet at phone width. It holds:
  - the player's own `name#tag` with a Copy button;
  - the add form by `name#tag`, showing the server's refusal in its own words;
  - incoming requests (Accept and Decline);
  - the friends list, online first, each row with its status dot and Challenge, Watch and Chat exactly as `TogetherRoute.tsx`'s `FriendRow` decides them today (the server's status, CLAUDE.md rule 7; no client-side legality);
  - a link to "All of Play together" (`/together`).
- Read the friends list (`FRIENDS_POLL_MS`) only while the panel is open, as `InMatchChat.tsx` already does for its list. SPEC §9.5's Presence bullet keeps its pace rule. Generalise its "the match board only while its chat list is open" to "any screen only while its friends panel is open".
- `/together` stays as the full page: blocked players, "Shared with me", outgoing requests and the co-op panel. Do not remove or redirect the route (CLAUDE.md rule 13). Reuse its row and request components in the panel instead of copying them.
- Escape closes it, focus is trapped while it is open, and focus returns to the button on close, like the client's other modals (`ChallengeDialog.tsx`, `game/ConfirmConcede.tsx`).

**3. Challenging takes one confirm**
- `ChallengeDialog.tsx` opens with the player's last challenge mode and deck (or trio) already chosen and Send focused, so a repeat challenge is Challenge then Enter. Remember the last pick per browser in the settings store (a per-viewer convenience). With nothing remembered, or a remembered deck that is no longer saved, fall back to the first saved deck in the current default mode. The server still decides whether the deck may be played (rule 7).
- The dialog opens from the friends panel without leaving the current screen. Sending a challenge from inside a match is not offered (the button is disabled there, with the server's reason in its title) because the server refuses it anyway (SPEC §9.5).

**4. Accepting takes one press**
- The incoming-challenge toast shows the challenge's mode and a deck picker with the player's last deck for that mode already chosen. **Accept joins the room straight from the toast** (`POST` to the room's join with that deck) and goes to the game. An All Random challenge needs no deck, so Accept just joins. If the join is refused (a deck the server rejects, the challenge gone), show the refusal in the toast and offer "Open in lobby", the current R767 path with the code filled in.
- This changes §9.5's "accepting it is joining the room by its code, the lobby opened with the code filled in". Rewrite that sentence: accepting is still joining the room by its code (which still marks the challenge accepted), now done from the toast with the chosen deck, the lobby being the fallback. Add a ruling note in this issue's block (R<this issue>000, `docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers) that records the change and cites R767. R767 itself still governs room *links*.
- R1754000 still holds: a screen with unsaved work (the card creator) asks before the toast's Accept leaves it.

Touches only `apps/web` (plus `spec/09-*.md`, the new ruling note, `spec/INDEX.md` through `cargo jackioh spec index`, `apps/web/README.md`'s "Play together and Duos" section, and `e2e/support/testids.ts` for the new test ids). No server, engine, card or AI change: every route it calls already exists.

### Acceptance

- The Friends button (`friends-button`) renders top-right, left of the settings gear, on the landing, `/play`, `/decks`, `/collection`, `/account`, `/replays`, the replay player, `/practice`, a live match board, the Duos board and `/watch` for a signed-in account, and not on `/login` or `/reset-password` (vitest, one test over the routes).
- Its badge (`friends-badge`) shows incoming requests plus incoming challenges plus unread chats from the shell's existing `SOCIAL_POLL_MS` read. No extra request to `/api/challenges` or the unread route is made per screen (counted against the stub server).
- `GET /api/friends` is called only while the panel is open, and polling stops when it closes.
- The panel (`friends-panel`) lists friends with status, Challenge, Watch and Chat as `/together` decides them. Its add form sends a request and shows a refusal in the server's words. Copy puts the player's `name#tag` on the clipboard. Escape closes it and focus returns to the button.
- On the match board there is one friends entry: `InMatchChat`'s separate toggle is gone, and chat with a friend opens from the panel.
- The challenge dialog opens with the last-used mode and deck chosen and Send focused. A deck no longer saved falls back to the first saved deck. Sending from the panel leaves the player on the screen they were on.
- The toast's Accept (`challenge-toast-accept`) joins the room with the chosen deck in one press and goes to the match. All Random needs no deck. A refused join shows the refusal and an "Open in lobby" (`challenge-toast-lobby`) that opens `/play` with the code filled in (R767).
- The new ruling's proving test is named after it (`it("R<n> …")`), `cargo jackioh spec check` passes, and §9.5's Play together, Challenging a friend and Presence bullets describe the new flow.
- At phone width (≤ 480 px) the panel is a full-width sheet, the top-right cluster doesn't wrap under Back or overlap the match bar's clock, and there's no horizontal scroll.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` pass. `e2e/cypress/e2e` specs that press `together-challenge` or the toast's Accept are updated to the new flow.

### Blocked by, part of

None.
```
